title: Surreal Moonlit Chimera
description: A surreal painting depicts a split-faced woman with one half pale and the other green with orange eyes, holding a golden snake that coils around her. Below her is a green and purple horse with a human face on its side, a rat at its feet, all framed by a cracked circular border dripping rainbow paint, set against a desert landscape with multiple moons and flowers.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork of a dual-faced woman, one side pale with closed eyes and the other vibrant green with orange spiral eyes, holding a golden scaled snake that coils around her body. Below her stands a green and purple horse with a human face melting from its torso, a small rat nearby. The scene is enclosed in a cracked circular frame adorned with purple flowers and dripping rainbow paint. Desert dunes in background under multiple detailed moons in a dark sky with geometric symbols and colorful flowers in foreground.
